args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

src/money.py was using ROUND_HALF_UP, causing nightly build test
failures. Switch to banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) as required
by FIN-212 and the existing test suite.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which broke the nightly build: `tests/test_money.py` requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including the `test_half_even` cases (`2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`).

Cc @alex for review.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
